data.name: Comic Shop Tycoon
data.detailed_description:
BUILD THE COMIC SHOP OF YOUR DREAMS

Comic Shop Tycoon is a first person shop management simulator where you start with a small comic book store and work to turn it into a successful business.

Order new inventory, unpack deliveries, stock your shelves, set your prices, ring up customers, and put your profits back into the store. Each day gives you another chance to improve the shop, bring in more products, and grow your business.

RUN YOUR SHOP YOUR WAY

You take care of the day to day work yourself. Keep your shelves stocked, clean up the store, manage incoming deliveries, work the register, and make sure your customers can find something they want to buy.

STOCK MORE THAN COMICS

As your store grows, so does the selection of products you can sell. Along with comic books, you can carry collectibles, figures, tabletop RPG books, dice, comic supplies, and other merchandise.

KEEP UP WITH NEW RELEASES

New comics arrive over time, so you will need to plan ahead, order what you need, and make room on your shelves. Keeping popular products in stock can make a big difference when customers come through the door.

GROW YOUR BUSINESS

Earn money and experience by running the store. Unlock new products, expand your available space, improve your shop, and keep working toward something bigger.

MAKE THE STORE YOURS

Decorate and customize your comic shop with posters, standees, fixtures, murals, and other items. Build a store that feels like your own and give customers a place they will want to come back to.

BUILD YOUR COMIC SHOP EMPIRE

Start small, learn the business, and build your store into the kind of comic shop you would want to visit yourself.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
